scope.constraints: homogeneous fixed constraints interpreted as comoving supports only after explicit WP07 input opt-in
scope.ground_spring_policy: a spring with a ground endpoint is admitted only when explicitly declared COMOVING_WITH_BASE
scope.operators: WP02 prepared full M/K and constrained reduction; WP04 admissible spectral domain
excluded: condensed/algebraic DOF maps not represented by the contracted P

physical_formulation.influence_vector: global-axis unit translation on active translational DOFs; zero on rotational DOFs
physical_formulation.coordinate_map_implemented: For the frozen WP00 domain, P is the full-to-free selector. Non-identity reduction transforms and condensed algebraic/drilling DOFs are rejected rather than approximated.
physical_formulation.mass_coupling: M_full*r_full is formed before P.T; free/constrained consistent-mass coupling is retained.
physical_formulation.rigid_base_stiffness_term: No separate K*r*x_g term is applied: the admitted structural and explicitly comoving spring references undergo the same rigid translation, so their relative deformation is unchanged. Non-comoving references fail closed.
physical_formulation.damping_frame: WP04 damping acts on structural relative velocity. No C*r*v_g term is added for rigid base translation; this frame is explicit and is not a general absolute-frame dashpot model.
physical_formulation.hypothesis_review: The reduced equation is valid only for the explicit comoving-support, homogeneous-relative-constraint, linear-operator scope above. No inference is made from historical fixed-DOF inputs when the WP07 object is absent.

input_contract.direction: already-normalized finite 3-vector in global_model_axes; norm error <= 1e-12

harmonic.internal_conversion: omega_rad_s=2*pi*frequency_hz exactly once at the method boundary
harmonic.zero_frequency: nonzero A_g is rejected; zero A_g can drive the relative DC force equation. Relative acceleration and absolute acceleration are available; absolute displacement and velocity remain unavailable because acceleration does not determine integration constants
harmonic.frequency_binding: exact one-to-one set match to the requested harmonic frequency grid; duplicates or missing frequencies fail closed

transient.history: finite real samples starting at t=0, strictly increasing
transient.initial_conditions: relative structural initial conditions; base displacement/velocity are not integrated or inferred

input_contract.force_superposition: WP03 external force channels and the equivalent base-inertia force are added once in full coordinates, then projected; K/M and ModalBasis remain reusable when only excitation changes.

damping_and_reactions.rayleigh: C=alpha*M+beta_R*K per WP04; applied to relative structural velocity, with beta_R distinct from Newmark beta
damping_and_reactions.prescribed_modal: WP04 reduced C_modal only; no full-space C is fabricated

transient_reactions.physical_rayleigh: AVAILABLE only for fixed-DOF residuals when full-space balance is reconstructible; residual uses M_full*a_abs + C_full*v_rel + K_full*u_rel - F_external
transient_reactions.harmonic: NOT_COMPUTED by the reduced harmonic result
transient_reactions.comoving_ground_spring_reference: UNAVAILABLE; the spring reference has no modeled physical DOF/reaction mapping and is not included in the fixed-DOF reaction vector

identity_and_restart.operator_reuse: Base-excitation mutation changes excitation/execution identity but not physical/operator identity or ModalBasis when structural inputs are unchanged.
identity_and_restart.modal_checkpoint: Existing qf-modal-newmark-checkpoint/v1 binds the combined WP03/WP07 excitation identity; incompatible or mutated excitation refuses resume.

result_contract.harmonic: relative velocity=i*omega*U_rel and relative acceleration=-omega^2*U_rel; absolute acceleration=relative acceleration+r_full*A_g; absolute displacement and velocity require positive-frequency base kinematics
result_contract.harmonic_zero_frequency: relative/absolute acceleration remain available; absolute displacement and velocity are UNAVAILABLE because integration constants are undefined
result_contract.transient_absolute: absolute acceleration is reconstructed from a_g; absolute displacement/velocity are unavailable without x_g/v_g history or declared integration constants
result_contract.unavailable_values: explicit status and reason; never substituted with zero
result_contract.serialization: additive fields in existing versioned result contracts; old payloads without WP07 fields remain readable
